Action.description: An action, tagged by `type`. An action runs only after the user approves it in the app.

oneOf.description:
Starts a program or opens a link. The field that the `kind` needs is required:
`appId` for `steam`, `path` for `exe`, `target` for `uri` and `url`.

appId.description: Steam app id. Required for kind `steam`.

fallback.description: Path or URI to try when `path` is missing. Kind `exe` only.

target.description: URI or URL. Required for kinds `uri` and `url`.

oneOf.description: Presses keys in order, once or in a loop.

cycleMs.description: Repeat period in ms. 0 or absent runs the sequence once.

holdMs.description: How long each key stays down in ms. Defaults to 30.

keyGapMs.description: Pause between keys in ms. Defaults to 50.

keys.description: Key names pressed in order, for example `["1", "2", "ctrl+q"]`. At least one.

toggle.description: When true, a tap starts the loop and the next tap stops it. Defaults to false.

oneOf.description: Runs a command from the allow-list in the app settings. Never a raw command line.
Switches to another page of this deck.

page.description: Id of the page to show.

LaunchKind.description:
What a launch action starts. Each kind needs one field: `steam` needs `appId`, `exe` needs
`path`, `uri` and `url` need `target`.

Page.description: One screen of widgets on a grid.

id.description:
Page id, unique in the deck. Matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$`. A `page` action
and `settings.homePage` refer to it.

title.description: Title shown to the user. 1 to 60 characters.

trigger.description:
Context rule. When set, the page opens when the rule becomes true and the deck
returns to the home page when it becomes false.

widgets.description:
Widgets on this page. Two widgets must not overlap and each must fit in the grid.
Widget ids must be unique on the page.

Position.description: Grid position, zero-based. The widget covers `w` columns and `h` rows from cell (`x`, `y`).

x.description: Column of the left edge, from 0.

y.description: Row of the top edge, from 0.

Settings.description: Deck-wide options. Every field is optional.

homePage.description:
Id of the page shown at start and after a context page closes. It must be the id of
a page in this deck.

Source.description: A named data feed, tagged by `kind`.

oneOf.description: CPU, GPU and memory numbers from this PC.

intervalMs.description: Poll interval in ms, at least 250. Defaults to 1000.

metrics.description:
Metrics to read, each at most once. Allowed: `cpu.load`, `cpu.temp`, `gpu.load`,
`gpu.temp`, `ram.used`, `ram.total`.

oneOf.description: Polls a web URL. The call runs only after the user approves the URL.

intervalSeconds.description: Seconds between polls, at least 5. Defaults to 60.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds before a poll times out, 1 to 60. Defaults to 10.

oneOf.description: Watches for running processes. A page `trigger` refers to this kind.

intervalMs.description: Check interval in ms, at least 500. Defaults to 2000.

processes.description: Process names to watch, at least one, each at most once.

ToggleLook.description:
How a toggle looks in one state. Every field is optional; a missing one falls back to the
widget's own `label` and `icon`, and to the default tile colour.

color.description: Tile colour in this state: a hex colour, `#rgb` or `#rrggbb`.

icon.description:
Icon in this state: a path inside the pack (`icons/...`), plain glyph text, or an https
URL. A remote icon is a network endpoint: a risk item that needs approval (SPEC §4.3).

label.description: Text under the tile in this state. At most 60 characters.

Trigger.description: Context rule that opens a page while a game runs.

source.description: Id of a `game_watch` source in `sources`. Any other kind of source is an error.

when.description: The condition that opens the page.

Widget.description:
A tile on a page. The `type` field picks the kind; each kind adds its own fields. A field
that the kind does not define is an error.

oneOf.description: Starts a program, game or link. `action` must be a `launch` action.

action.description: The launch action to run on tap.

holdAction.description:
Optional second action that runs on a long press (held at least 600 ms without
moving). It must be a `launch` action, like `action`. It is a risk item like
`action`: it runs only after the user approves it. A long press never also runs
`action`.

order.description:
`fixed` keeps deck order. `recent` sorts by local play history at render time.
Defaults to `fixed`.

oneOf.description: Sends keys. `action` must be a `key_macro` action.

action.description: The key macro to run on tap.

holdAction.description:
Optional second action that runs on a long press (held at least 600 ms without
moving). It must be a `key_macro` action, like `action`. It is a risk item like
`action`: it runs only after the user approves it. A long press never also runs
`action`.

oneOf.description:
A tile with two states. A tap while off runs `onAction` and switches the tile on; a tap
while on runs `offAction` (if set) and switches it off. The state is kept on this
device between runs, never in the deck file. It starts off. Each action is a risk item.

off.description:
Look while off. Missing fields use the widget's own `label` and `icon`, and the
default tile colour.

offAction.description: Action that runs when the tile switches off. Without it, switching off runs nothing.

on.description:
Look while on. Missing fields use the widget's own `label` and `icon`, and the
default tile colour.

onAction.description: Action that runs when the tile switches on.

oneOf.description: Shows a number from a source as a gauge.

max.description: Value at the full end. Defaults to 100.

metric.description:
Metric name: a key of the source's flat payload, for example `cpu.load` or
`gpu.temp`. It is not a JSON path. A missing or null value shows "no data".

min.description: Value at the empty end. Defaults to 0.

unit.description: Unit shown after the value. At most 8 characters.

oneOf.description: Shows OK or a problem from a source value.

okWhen.description:
Value that counts as OK. Anything else shows as a problem. A numeric `okWhen`
compares as a number, so `1` matches `1.0`. Any other `okWhen` compares as text.
When omitted, any non-zero value is OK.

path.description:
Metric name: a key of the source's flat payload, for example `cpu.load`. It is not
a JSON path. A missing or null value shows "no data".

oneOf.description: A label, a clock or a date.

hour12.description:
Clock only. `true` shows 12-hour time with AM or PM. `false` shows 24-hour time.
Omit it to follow the system setting.

kind.description: `label` shows `text`. `clock` and `date` show the time. Defaults to `label`.

seconds.description: Clock only. `true` shows seconds. Defaults to `false`.

showDate.description:
Clock only. `true` shows the date in a smaller line under the time. Defaults to
`false`. The `date` kind always shows the date.

text.description: Text for the `label` kind. At most 200 characters.

oneOf.description:
A counter tile. A tap adds `step` to the value; a long press (held at least 600 ms)
resets it to `start`. The value is kept on this device between runs, never in the deck
file. It runs no action and is not a risk item. The tile shows the widget `label`.

max.description: Highest value. The count stops here. Optional.

min.description: Lowest value. The count stops here. Optional.

start.description:
First value, and the value after a reset. Defaults to 0. When `min` or `max` is set,
`start` must lie between them.

step.description: Amount added by each tap. May be negative. Must not be 0. Defaults to 1.

oneOf.description:
A countdown or stopwatch tile. A tap starts, pauses and resumes it; a long press (held
at least 600 ms) resets it. At the end of a countdown the tile changes colour and
pulses until the next tap. No sound. The state is kept in memory only: it is lost when
the app closes. It runs no action and is not a risk item. The tile shows the widget
`label`.

durationS.description:
Countdown only: length in seconds, 1 to 86400. Required for a countdown. A
stopwatch must not set it.

oneOf.description:
A volume slider and mute button for the default output device. The slider is
horizontal on a tile that is wider than it is tall, and vertical otherwise. It runs no
action and is not a risk item. The tile shows the widget `label`.

Controls the system media session (any player that reports to Windows). It has no
provider and no volume control.

controls.description: Controls to show. Each appears at most once.

oneOf.description: Shows a web page. The page gets no access to the app.

refreshSeconds.description: Seconds between reloads. 0 or absent means no reload.

icon.description:
Icon: a path inside the pack (`icons/...`), plain glyph text, or an https URL. A remote
icon is a network endpoint: a risk item that needs approval (SPEC §4.3).

id.description: Widget id, unique on its page. Matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$`.

label.description: Text under the tile. At most 60 characters.

position.description:
Where the widget sits on the grid. Omit it and the app places the widget in the first
free cell in reading order (row by row, left to right); it then covers one cell.

description:
An EasyDeck deck: pages of widgets. A widget runs an action or shows a value from a source.
An LLM may write or change this file only; it never changes app code.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema, for editors.

name.description: Deck name, shown to the user. 1 to 80 characters.

pages.description:
The pages of the deck, at least one. The first page is the home page unless
`settings.homePage` names another.

sources.description:
Named data feeds. Each key is a source id that gauge and status widgets and page
triggers refer to. A key matches `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$`.

title: EasyDeck deck
